suppliers.suppliers: Agricultural Trading Company (ATC), ETG Inputs at Boma; Lupembe Rice Farmers Cooperative for certified rice seeds.
Misuku Coffee Cooperative Depot (specialty fertilizers); Farmers World and Chipiku Stores at Boma.
Mzuzu GreenGrow Agrovert, PANNAR seed networks, NASFAM smallholder aggregate hubs.
Agro-Input Suppliers Limited (AISL), Cropserve Malawi, Farmers Organization Ltd (FOL) at Kanengo; One Acre Fund EPA depots.
Yara Malawi, Optichem, Malawi Fertilizer Company commercial retail outlets near Kasungu Boma.
Agwenda Investments network, Elvima Investment seed hubs at Mponela.
Maziko Agriculture Enterprises, Sarvious Agrodealer, AB Mwale Commodities.
Limbe industrial warehouses: Chikondi Farm Inputs, Agora, Ngondo Agrodealers, Emmanuel Enterprises.
Mulli Brothers Limited local points, independent dealers backed by Shire Valley Transformation Program (SVTP).
Vickys Shop and Agrodealer, Home Boys Agro-dealers, Tea Research Foundation of Central Africa (TRFCA) technical sales.

maize.transport: 1 x 8-MT rigid flatbed truck lined with wooden pallets & covered with waterproof PVC tarp.
maize.buyers: NFRA, Large commercial millers (Bakhresa, Chombe, Mwendo)
maize.avoid: ADMARC depots, urban grain wholesalers, farm-gate vendors (Alonda) for loss
maize.booking: Book 14 Days Before Harvest based on final moisture test (<14%).

rice.transport: 1 x 7-MT flatbed or rigid box truck. Clean woven polypropylene sacks on pallets.
rice.avoid: ADMARC depots, local traders, open markets
rice.booking: Book 10 Days Before Harvest. Matches post-threshing grading cycle.

soya.transport: 1 x 3-MT or 5-MT box truck. Zero contact with fuel/chemicals.
soya.buyers: Sunseed Oil, Mount Meru, Capital Oil Refineries (CORI), AHXL/ACE Exchanges
soya.avoid: Institutional buyers, NASFAM pooling centers, local vendors (loss)
soya.booking: Book 10 Days Before Harvest. Scheduled at the completion of threshing.

groundnut.transport: 1 x 3-MT well-ventilated slatted truck. Avoid enclosed boxes to prevent sweating.
groundnut.buyers: Large industrial processors, Exporters, ACE/AHXL commodity exchanges
groundnut.avoid: NASFAM local depots, urban markets, farm-gate vendors (loss)
groundnut.booking: Book 14 Days Before Harvest. Arranged during field pull-and-windrow drying phase.

bean.transport: 1 x 3-MT rigid truck or light delivery vehicle, bags stacked on pallets.
bean.buyers: High-end retail chains, formal seed companies, urban packaging hubs
bean.avoid: Institutional buyers, city open markets, roadside traders (loss)
bean.booking: Book 7 Days Before Harvest. Arranged during pod-drying checks to hit early high prices.

cotton.transport: 1 x 3-MT open flatbed truck fitted with high bamboo/wire framework extensions.
cotton.buyers: Quton, formal ginneries under structural contract pricing
cotton.booking: Book 14 Days Before Harvest. Scheduled at the first major open-boll wave.
